text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One major problem is bias. AI systems can learn unfair patterns from data, which may lead to discrimination against certain groups. To prevent this, we need fairness in the design of these systems. Privacy is another key concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies should protect this data carefully. Transparency is also essential: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means creating technology that benefits everyone and respects human values. Governments, scientists and companies must work together to achieve these goals.
